Human completes own Claude login if absent, account/auth/billing source and bounded test usage agreed, installed supported CLI/hosts and writable isolated session roots confirmed without copying tokens; no secrets in chat or fixtures. Existing cost acknowledgement retained; only missing specifics requested before live execution.

## Verification

Provide changed-path and command/version receipts; coordinator inspects diff and reruns focused meaningful checks before closure. Test/spec status must distinguish simulated/replay checks from authenticated live execution.


## Decision

Pending. Resolve only with the explicit authority and evidence in Acceptance Criteria; this planning turn does not decide or execute it.

## Rationale

Keep implementation authority, compatibility/auth choices and live account readiness explicit rather than hiding them in worker assumptions.

## Alternatives Considered

Starting from a favourable design discussion is rejected. SDK versus CLI default, retained versus migrated legacy support and named authentication choices require the policy receipt. Missing live credentials block real verification rather than silently dropping it.
acceptance_criteria: Human completes own Claude login if absent, account/auth/billing source and bounded test usage agreed, installed supported CLI/hosts and writable isolated session roots confirmed without copying tokens; no secrets in chat or fixtures. Existing cost acknowledgement retained; only missing specifics requested before live execution.
close_reason: Live runs explicitly authorized. Installed Claude2.1.285/Pi0.99.1/OMP18.4.4 verified; claude auth status reports first-party Max logged in; no API credential/base URL override. title: Modernize Claude runtime with two drivers and native Pi/OMP adapters
description:
## Destination

Modernize this extension with a neutral core, SDK/CLI drivers, Pi/OMP adapters and four real E2E combinations, using validated specifications and disjoint parallel lanes. Implementation is deferred.

## Notes

OpenSpec: openspec/changes/modernize-claude-runtime. Coordination owns board/spec status; integration owns shared/legacy files; contracts freeze before max-three-slot worker dispatch. Wayfinder decisions are distinct from implementation slices requested by Ramiro. No publishing or paid tests occur in planning.

## Decisions so far

- Existing Claude SDK Pi providers and T3/BB patterns inform reuse; details live in change research/ and design.md.
- Explicit dual drivers and distinct Pi/OMP host adapters are the approved planning scope.

## Not yet specified

Final tested version/default/legacy-migration and exact dependency/auth/tool ownership details are the policy decision ticket; query its named child bead. Live account specifics belong to authenticated-test readiness.

## Out of scope

Direct HTTP subscription identity imitation, custom auth collection, auto-fallback after side effects, delegated-worker redesign and automatic publishing.

## Success Criteria

All eight OpenSpec capabilities satisfied with four real host/driver E2E combinations, meaningful offline coverage, disjoint lane evidence and documented tested compatibility. Planning completion does not satisfy implementation completion.
